title: Induced packing treewidth II. Excluding a clique or a biclique
summary: The notion of induced packing treewidth aims to unify classes defined by forbidden induced subgraphs or induced minors with classes defined by the existence of certain structured tree decompositions. For a graph $H$, \emph{induced $H$-packing treewidth}, denoted by $\treepi_{H}$, is a tree-decomposition-based graph parameter that, for each bag, measures the maximum number of pairwise anticomplete induced copies of $H$ intersecting that bag.
